_doc: North-star state consumed by .codex/hooks/pre_write_north_star_gate.py. The gate stays armed while enabled=true and lanes_passing < lanes_total; update lanes_passing as apps_rg E2E lanes go X3_ALLOW. recent_north_star_pct seeds the EARNED confidence in the AskUserQuestion (lower north-star % => higher 'park it' confidence). goals[] is the human-readable, time-boxed program; gate logic reads only lanes_passing/lanes_total/enabled/recent_north_star_pct.
north_star: Multi-app delivery program (2026-06-15). Ship apps_rg + apps_lic on deadline, then apps_eval + L6 shadow observability (apps_eval feeds eval signals into ALL apps_*), then apps_underwriting_ai as the next major app. See goals[].

goals.target: 5 end-to-end resumes generated (assembled DOCX in hand)
goals.note: Technical enabler: 11/11 lanes X3_ALLOW + sliding-scale graph skills. lanes_passing/lanes_total track this dimension.

goals.target: establish which evals actually work; codify how they incorporate into L6 shadow observability (spearman)
goals.note: Operator's weakest area. apps_eval is cross-cutting: it feeds eval signals into ALL apps_* (every app, including apps_underwriting_ai), not just apps_rg/apps_lic. Learn from apps_rg + apps_lic eval signals first, then generalize.

goals.target: L6 shadow observability (spearman) wired and OPEN-resolved for apps_rg AND apps_lic
goals.note: Currently OPEN for both apps_rg and apps_lic.

goals.target: stand up apps_underwriting_ai end-to-end — the next major app after apps_rg + apps_lic ship and apps_eval generalizes
goals.note: Next priority after apps_lic + apps_eval. Benefits directly from apps_eval, which feeds eval signals into all apps_* (this app included). Reference: docs/reference/_primers/AgentSpec/apps_underwriting_ai_reference_implementation.md.
